sol-2-1.summary: InTotoStatement.toJson duplicates the schema-backed JSON options shape in an anonymous configuration type, contrary to EF-33 and the schema-first configuration contract.
sol-2-1.fix: Add import type { SbomJsonOptions } from ./Sbom.ts and use toJson(options?: SbomJsonOptions): string. Preserve options?.space ?? 0, the existing codec/validation boundary, wire key order and upstream serializer assertions. Do not add options decoding or change the default. Only InTotoStatement.ts needs editing; the type-only import adds no runtime dependency and no test edits are necessary.
